Interface Activatable

All Superinterfaces:
ComponentInterface
All Known Implementing Classes:
DoubleCannon, DoubleEngine, Shield
public sealed interface Activatable extends ComponentInterface permits DoubleCannon, DoubleEngine, Shield
Interface representing components that can be activated or deactivated in the ship building phase. This interface is implemented by components such as DoubleCannon, DoubleEngine, and Shield.
